symbolRegressionCheck.priorPhaseNote: Every prior-phase symbol checked, including Phase 17's own Detection Accuracy Analytics functions and Phase 19's own normalize_word_token, remains present and unregressed.

newSymbolsThisPhase.note: fuzzy_match_book and canonicalize_book (the public API surface new/changed code calls into) are directly confirmed present. correct_scripture_context is present at count 2, consistent with this project's established pattern for Tauri command functions (a wrapper + inner mangled symbol, or two call sites - matching e.g. retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context's own count of 2). resolve_fuzzy_book, levenshtein, and max_allowed_distance were inlined by the release-mode optimizer, as expected for small functions with a single call site or pure small helpers - consistent with this project's own established precedent (e.g. ordinal_value in Phase 19, classify_overload/chunk_duration_ms in Phase 3.8.7.3), where caller/API-surface presence plus a fully passing unit-test suite has repeatedly been treated as sufficient evidence rather than a gap.

frontendTextSearchLimitation: The frontend bundle is bundled into the Tauri resources directory, not searchable as plain strings inside cip-desktop.exe the same way Rust symbols are. The new 'fuzzy_book' ReferenceKind union member and the manual-entry hint/placeholder text changes were not independently string-searched, consistent with every prior phase's methodology. Frontend correctness for this phase rests on npm run typecheck's success and the full 303/303 frontend test pass (unchanged from Phase 18, since no new frontend test was needed - the manual-entry fix reuses an already-tested backend function).
architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero new Tauri commands, zero new events, zero new migrations, zero schema changes.
ReferenceKind::FuzzyBook never mutates ScriptureContext - confirmed by a dedicated regression test (fuzzy_book_name_never_establishes_active_context) in core/service/src/bible_intelligence.rs.
correct_scripture_context's new behavior is strictly more permissive than before (accepts everything it did previously, plus full names/abbreviations) - no existing valid input becomes invalid.
Every other domain contract crate (core/sermon, core/music, core/presentation) is entirely untouched.
Every prior-phase command and Phase 14-19 symbol remains present and unregressed, confirming this phase's addition did not disturb any prior gate or feature.
